## W6 - Follow-ups (daily 10:00 India time)
For every ACTIVE clinic in the Agency Registry:
1. **No-show rebook** - appointments marked No-show yesterday or the day before, Rebook_Sent empty, patient has no new booking -> "we missed you" message (one per patient).
2. **Day-2 follow-up** - leads still New / Contacted, created 2-6 days ago, Followup_Sent off, nothing booked -> one "would you like to book?" message.
3. **Mark Lost** - leads still New / Contacted 7+ days after they came in, nothing booked, no future Next_Action_At -> Status = Lost, Lost_Reason = No response.
   This one is a REAL change today (it is not a message). Set mark_lost to false in Config to switch it off.

**Messages are a STUB today.** "Send message (stub)" builds them and sends nothing; no flag is set, so nothing is lost when WhatsApp goes live.
The send guard runs first: skips opted-out patients, conversations with Automation_Paused (follow-ups count as marketing), quiet hours;
TEST_MODE (or the row missing) sends to TEST_PHONE. The booking link comes from Settings > booking_link.

**Config:** lookback 2 days for no-shows, follow-up after 2 days, Lost after 7 days, max 30 follow-ups and 50 Lost per clinic per run.
**Set up once:** pick the *Grist API* credential in every Grist (HTTP Request) node, set registry_doc_id, Settings > Error workflow > W11, Activate.
**When WhatsApp is ready:** replace "Send message (stub)" with the real send (output sent: true on success).
